theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_dlc_accumulating_discs
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (z : ℕ → Euclid P) (k : ℕ → ℕ) (b : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → 0 < ρ → (∀ i, Module.finrank ℝ (Q i) = 2) → (∀ i, z i ∈ Q i) → Tendsto z atTop (𝓝 b) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ (Q i : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (z i) ρ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ C.support ∩ ball x ε = (Q i : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x ε ∧ (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball x ε → HasMassDensity C y (k i)) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball x ε → μHE[2] (W ∩ (Q i : Set (Euclid P))) ≤ C.massOn W) → (¬ ∃ (ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < ε ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball b ε → HasMassDensity C y m) → False
